documents_expected.why: call page: who can apply, match, deadline
the RFP: eligibility, site visit, application tabs, reporting
the 30-year protective agreement for Tracks 5 and 6

eligibility.rule: Tracks 1, 2, 3 and 6: a 501(c) non-profit (Annapolis community associations excepted)
eligibility.quote: applicants for Tracks 1, 2, 3, and 6 must be certified 501(c) non-profit organizations, except for homeowners or community associations located in the City of Annapolis.

eligibility.rule: Tracks 1, 2, 3 and 6: at least one partner based in Anne Arundel County
eligibility.quote: Applications for Tracks 1, 2, 3, and 6 must include at least one partner that represents a stakeholder group based in Anne Arundel County.

eligibility.rule: Project in Anne Arundel County, including Annapolis
eligibility.quote: Eligible Project Locations: Anne Arundel County and City of Annapolis.

eligibility.rule: Voluntary work only, not required by a permit or mitigation
eligibility.quote: All projects proposed shall be voluntary.

eligibility.rule: Completed within two years of the award
eligibility.quote: Projects must be completed within two years upon receipt of the award.

eligibility.rule: Executive Officer and Project Leader are two different people who can decide for the organisation
eligibility.quote: Both an Executive Officer and a Project Leader, two separate individuals, must be identified for all applications.

documents.item: Narrative questions for the track (5 pages max)
documents.quote: You will be asked to upload an MS Word or PDF file (5-page limit, excluding question prompts and materials such as Letters of Commitments, photos, and other supporting documents) addressing the narrative questions

documents.item: Itemised budget with a budget narrative
documents.quote: You will also be asked to provide a descriptive budget narrative to justify and explain costs.
with landowner permission documented through a Letter of Commitment included in your application.

effort.step: Pre-application site visit with the Trust
effort.quote: The Trust requires that all applicants conduct a pre-application site visit with the Trust by February 12, 2027.

effort.step: Submit in the Trust's online system
effort.quote: Applicants must submit applications in the Chesapeake Bay Trust Online System by 4:00 PM ET on February 26, 2027.

co_finance_required.quote: Match is not required in this program but viewed favorably by reviewers.
alt_quotes: Match is encouraged, but not required.

after_award.quote: the Trust will send an award agreement with award conditions and due dates of status, progress, and final reports.

notes: Six tracks with different caps and owners; Tracks 5 and 6 need a 30-year Long Term Protective Agreement. 10% of the award is held until the final report is approved. The track-specific narrative templates are linked but were not read. Gather fills 6 of its slots with privacy and Climate Corps pages.
